question: What does fitting twelve contexts add beyond simpler local word representations (single-context contrasts; the receiver's own input embeddings), on the SAME packets?

constructions.c12: the current twelve-context mean at the frozen depth-0.2 layer (asserted equal to the stored R0 direction)
constructions.single_t0: single fitting context at list position 0
constructions.single_t6: single fitting context at list position 6 (= 12//2)
constructions.single_t11: single fitting context at list position 11
constructions.single_nm: each single-context direction rescaled by ONE receiver-local scalar s = median over words of ||c12[w]||/||single[w]|| (fitting contexts only); gamma 1 only; a norm diagnostic, no grid
constructions.source: all from the per-word R0 fit blobs (stored per-context contrasts); no refit, no new fitting forward; no fitting context contains a scene or an answer

single_t0.message: Selected words and exact relative weights (integers divided by 255): XOPA: <WORD> [255/255], unknown [255/255]; YUME: unknown [255/255], unknown [255/255].

single_t6.message: Selected words and exact relative weights (integers divided by 255): XOPA: unknown [255/255], unknown [255/255], <WORD> [255/255], unknown [255/255]; YUME: unknown [255/255], unknown [255/255], unknown [255/255], unknown [255/255].

single_t11.message: Selected words and exact relative weights (integers divided by 255): XOPA: unknown [255/255], unknown [255/255], unknown [255/255], unknown [255/255]; YUME: unknown [255/255], unknown [255/255], unknown [255/255], <WORD> [255/255].

pre_outcome_geometry.note: at depth 0.2 the single-context directions are already 0.86-0.99 cosine to the twelve-context mean (measured before any outcome); a small difference between constructions is therefore the prior expectation

embedding.module: receiver.model.get_input_embeddings() — the receiver's own input-embedding module at its native input location (Gemma's scaled embedding included; no projection, no training)
embedding.full_span: engineering identity: the packet-text prompt run through inputs_embeds = embedding_module(ids) must reproduce the ids-path logits (max |diff| <= 1e-4); the text rows then stand for that route; recorded as an identity, not as evidence
embedding.one_position: emb1@g: at each active slot the neutral token's embedding e_n is replaced by e_n + g * relative_weight * (pool(e(word tokens in the field context)) - e_n); pool = MEAN over the word's tokens as split in its actual field context (the prompt with the words in their slots); a POOLING ADAPTATION for multi-token words
embedding.identity_on_this_bank: measured before any outcome (p0a_dev_token_strata.json): on the development bank EVERY active word is a single token in its field for all four receivers and both sources (92/92 scenes), so emb1@1 is EXACTLY the packet-text route there — an identity, not an independent baseline; the dose grid for emb1 is the only non-identical part

selection.rule: per receiver and construction (c12, single_t0, single_t6, single_t11, emb1): eligible if strict coverage >= 0.90; highest J, then higher U, then raw scale, then smaller gamma
selection.selected_on: the COMPLETE-FACT (literal) source on development, which isolates receiver behaviour; the same dose is used for both sources at confirmation; gamma = 1 is always reported as well

numerics: FP32 eager, TF32 off, batch 1, cache reuse with the established fingerprint/clone checks; 64-token primary, 256-token sensitivity; strict first-line parser
not_done: no new sender, no new model, no layer search; the development results select doses only; the frozen current-method result (v2) is unchanged
